nodes.name: Generate with PICC
nodes.notes: GATED ROUTE. /api/content/generate now requires requireAuth (handlers.mjs), so this node MUST send a bearer token or it will get 401. The token is resolved at RUN TIME from $vars.PICC_CONTENT_PIPELINE_TOKEN (preferred, set in n8n under Variables) or $env.PICC_CONTENT_PIPELINE_TOKEN, and is deliberately NOT written into this exported workflow - an exported JSON is a tracked file, so a literal secret here would be a committed credential. Grant that token the operator's session, or use a dedicated service account. If the variable is unset the header renders as 'Bearer ' and the route answers 401, which is the honest failure rather than a silent success.
